research_question: Do ESM-2 masked-marginal scores rank single mutants of SDA_BACSU by measured DMS fitness, and can closed-loop measurement improve the top-5 selection?
control_variables: same WT sequence, single substitutions, masked-marginal scorer
execution_evidence: run_model score_variant A16C -> -6.8153; A16D -> -9.6519 (E1). query_evidence_oracle A16C -> -0.53393 (E3, historical ProteinGym SDA_BACSU Tsuboyama).
uncertainty: Single E3 point; E3 scale/units not yet characterized; cannot infer correlation from n=1.
conclusion: Interface verified: ESM-2 score_variant returns E1 delta log-likelihood; oracle returns a scalar historical measurement (E3) for a candidate. A16C E1=-6.82 vs E3=-0.534.
limitations: measurement scale unknown beyond sign convention (higher=better per task spec).

research_question: Which single mutants of SDA_BACSU have the highest measured DMS fitness, and can ESM-2 ranking plus adaptive measurement identify them?
control_variables: Same WT, single substitutions, same masked-marginal ESM-2, same historical oracle
candidate pool enriched for high ESM-2 (positions 2,12,14,19,22,23,24,37,39,40,43).
execution_evidence: query_evidence_oracle returned measurements for S37N, M19L, N22D, H40N, R2N, G39N, G39S, F14Y, S12A, S43N, D24E, R23N (12 queries, ordinals 3-14).
uncertainty: Weak E1-E3 agreement (rho 0.13); S12A outlier may be substitution-specific; top-quartile threshold unknown.
conclusion: Round-1: 12 top-ESM-2 candidates measured. Spearman rho(E1,E3)=0.126 (n=12), weak. Top-ESM-2 candidate S37N measured +0.137 (not top); S12A (ESM-2 rank 9) measured +0.467, the clear best. Measured values range -0.363 to +0.467 among enriched candidates.

research_question: Which single mutants of SDA_BACSU have the highest measured DMS fitness?
control_variables: Same WT, single substitutions, same oracle. Control: I42Q (mid ESM-2 rank) measured -1.028, confirming the measurement scale.
uncertainty: Position 12 hotspot is supported by 4 positive measurements; top-quartile threshold inferred indirectly from the enriched sample and control.
conclusion: Round 2: position 12 (WT S) is a strong hotspot for high fitness: S12T +0.513, S12V +0.484, S12A +0.467, S12C +0.234, but S12G -0.583. Other substitutions at round-1 positions did not generalize (S37T -0.387, D24N -0.100, N22E -0.058, M19I -0.638, G39A -0.082). Mid-tier control I42Q measured -1.028.
limitations: within-position ESM-2 ranking untested for position 12.

research_question: Which single mutants of SDA_BACSU have the highest measured DMS fitness?
control_variables: masked-marginal ESM-2 used only as a weak prior
final ranking by measured E3 fitness, not E1.
execution_evidence: 24 query_evidence_oracle measurements recorded (ev-1 interface A16C, ev-2 round1 n=12, ev-3 round2 n=11); final_selection.json written to the run output directory.
uncertainty: Top-5 confidence high for the four position-12 entries (all >0.23 vs control -1.03); G39S at +0.157 is the most uncertain but is the highest measured among non-position-12 candidates.
conclusion: FINAL: top-5 mutants by measured fitness are S12T (+0.513), S12V (+0.484), S12A (+0.467), S12C (+0.234), G39S (+0.157). Position 12 (WT S) is a verified high-fitness hotspot; the four position-12 substitutions are the strongest candidates, and G39S is the best of the remaining measured set. This is supported by 24 E3 measurements (all within budget) and a closed-loop revision after round 1 refuted ESM-2 rank dominance.
limitations: position-12 hotspot inferred from 5 measured substitutions at that position.
